crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
“Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
translations.bsb: Listen to this, O Job; stand still and consider the wonders of God.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
translations.asv: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
